    22	/-- For a finite pairwise-coprime family of ideals, the product equals the
    23	intersection (written as an indexed infimum). -/
    24	theorem chinese_remainder_inf_eq_prod
    25	    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    26	    (I : ι → Ideal R) (hI : Pairwise (IsCoprime on I)) :
    27	    (⨅ i, I i) = ∏ i, I i := by
    28	  symm
    29	  have h := Ideal.prod_eq_iInf_of_pairwise_isCoprime

    32	      exact hI)

    34	
    35	/-- The Chinese remainder ring equivalence for a finite family of pairwise
    36	coprime ideals. -/
    37	noncomputable def chinese_remainder
    38	    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    39	    (I : ι → Ideal R) (hI : Pairwise (IsCoprime on I)) :
    40	    (R ⧸ ⨅ i, I i) ≃+* ∀ i, R ⧸ I i :=
    41	  Ideal.quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient I hI
    42	
    43	/-- The Chinese remainder ring equivalence with the product ideal as source.
    44	This is the finite-family form of the statement in the Stacks Project. -/
    45	noncomputable def chinese_remainder_prod
    46	    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    47	    (I : ι → Ideal R) (hI : Pairwise (IsCoprime on I)) :
    48	    (R ⧸ ∏ i, I i) ≃+* ∀ i, R ⧸ I i := by
    49	  exact (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq (chinese_remainder_inf_eq_prod I hI).symm).trans
    50	    (Ideal.quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient I hI)
    51	
    52	/-- Chinese remainder for two pairwise-coprime ideals. -/
    53	noncomputable def chinese_remainder_two
    54	    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I J : Ideal R)
    55	    (hIJ : IsCoprime I J) :
    56	    (R ⧸ I ⊓ J) ≃+* (R ⧸ I) × R ⧸ J :=
    57	  Ideal.quotientInfEquivQuotientProd I J hIJ
    58	
    59	/-- Pairwise distinct maximal ideals are pairwise coprime, hence satisfy the
    60	Chinese remainder theorem. -/
    61	noncomputable def chinese_remainder_maximal
    62	    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    63	    (m : ι → Ideal R) (hm : ∀ i, (m i).IsMaximal)
    64	    (hne : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ m i ≠ m j)) :
    65	    (R ⧸ ⨅ i, m i) ≃+* ∀ i, R ⧸ m i := by
    66	  apply chinese_remainder m

    68	  letI : (m i).IsMaximal := hm i
    69	  letI : (m j).IsMaximal := hm j
